shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile, high relief
crouching/crawling predator with head lowered and forelegs extended
flat low-relief quadruped with splayed legs and clawed feet
several animals combined on one stone surface
incised linear detailing (hatching/striations) on animal bodies
justification: Both surfaces combine a boldly projecting quadruped predator, crouched with lowered head and clawed forelimbs, with flatter low-relief animals whose splayed limbs and hatched detailing are rendered in the same schematic-but-anatomical convention, and both set several animals in repeated rows on a single architectural stone. The largest differences in content are B's much richer programme, with a banded register of animals under arch-like forms, a zigzag/net band, human-like small figures and a long-necked bird, none of which appears in A, whose scene is limited to one relief animal beside one incised quadruped.
